rows.section: Tariff rules (Jura)
rows.label: Married couples and single parents
rows.value: Married couples and single persons keeping a household alone with dependent children or supported persons use the preferential tariff (barème préférentiel, art. 35 al. 1 LI)

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Delémont; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Delémont; other communes in Jura set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.section: Corporate profit tax 2026 (Jura)
rows.label: Unit profit tax rate for tax period 2026
rows.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.
rows.source_title: AFC/ESTV Feuille cantonale Jura (Etat février 2026), personnes morales: calcul de l'impôt, Art. 77 and 218c LI

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Jura)
rows.label: Who levies it
rows.value: Every municipality (taxe immobilière), on the official value of real estate of natural and legal persons
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

rows.section: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Jura)
rows.label: Rate range
rows.value: 0.5 to 1.8 per mille of the official value
rows.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).
rows.source_title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

rows.section: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Jura)
rows.label: Transfer duty rate
rows.value: Not confirmed for 2026: the ESTV gives 2.1% (legislation as of 1 January 2022); a 2023 government bill (Plan équilibre 22-26) proposed 2.5% up to CHF 1 million and 2.9% above and the end of the reduced rate for a first home; the law in force was not read
rows.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
rows.source_title: République et Canton du Jura: Plan équilibre 22-26, révision partielle de la loi réglant les droits de mutation (LDMG), press release of 03.07.2023; ESTV Dossier Handänderungssteuer (legislation as of 1 January 2022)
